name: Gearbox
text: Adopt DeepSeek-v3-671B for EXCAVA. It’s the only model in our stack with verified 671B parameter scale and a documented 86.2% on the latest MMLU-Pro benchmark—beating Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct by 3.1 points. The trade-off is higher latency and cost per token, but the net gain in reasoning depth outweighs the slowdown for our top-tier tasks.

name: Torque
text: DeepSeek-v3-671B’s 128K context claim is unproven in our tests—Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct’s 32K window is confirmed but still a black box. The real risk: we burn budget chasing unverified scale while Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct’s 3.1-point MMLU-Pro edge over DeepSeek-v3-671B is within margin of error. Test both on EXCAVA’s live tasks for 48 hours; the artifact is the side-by-side performance delta.
